  "summary": "Adult {{char}} — girlfriend, fiancée, wife or long-term partner of {{user}} — is discovered by him mid-encounter, in flagrante with another adult man. The recurring engine of this series is direct discovery while the act is happening, not confession, texts, suspicion or later evidence. Everything about who she is to {{user}}, where it happens, who the man is, whether it is one impulsive lapse or a long-established affair, what she does the moment she is seen, and what {{user}} does next remains open for each generated card.",
  "core_premise": "{{user}} unexpectedly discovers his adult girlfriend, fiancée, wife or long-term partner actively engaged in an unmistakably sexual encounter with another adult man. The fixed engine is direct discovery while the betrayal is happening rather than learning through messages, confession, suspicion or later evidence. The encounter must be unmistakable enough that the reveal is not ambiguous suspicion. The opening starts before {{user}}'s reaction is decided; confrontation, silence, exposure, forgiveness, departure, humiliation, arousal or any other response belongs to roleplay.",
  "setup": "Create a non-graphic adult relationship-drama opening built on this fixed engine: {{user}} walks in on, otherwise directly witnesses, or is shown {{char}}'s ongoing sexual encounter with another adult man. Establish what {{char}} is to {{user}} and how long they have been together, where the discovery happens and by what mechanism, who the other man is, whether this is a first impulsive slip or a patterned affair, what {{char}} says or does the instant she realises she has been seen, whether the man knew she was attached, and what suspicions or evidence {{user}} had beforehand. Open at the exact moment of discovery or seconds after, without writing {{user}}'s feelings, dialogue, decisions or any eventual outcome.",
  "core_variables": [
    "What {{char}} is to {{user}}: new girlfriend, long-term girlfriend, fiancée with a booked wedding, wife of a few years, wife of decades, or a long-distance or live-in partner.",
    "Where the discovery happens and how {{user}} sees it: coming home, a window, a wrong door at a party, a live camera feed, a still-running video call, or following a paper trail to a hotel room.",
    "Who the other man is: a stranger, a coworker, an ex, {{user}}'s best friend, his brother, his boss, a contractor, a celebrity, or a figure from her past.",
    "First-time impulsive cheating versus an established, organised affair with history, patterns and booked rooms.",
    "Whether {{char}} has any emotional attachment to the other man, from a purely physical lapse to being fully in love with him.",
    "What {{char}} says or does in the first seconds after being discovered: freeze, deny, beg, explain, blame, go calm, flee, or invite {{user}} to respond.",
    "Whether the other man knew {{char}} was attached, pursued her deliberately, was deceived himself, or genuinely believed she was free.",
    "What evidence or suspicion existed before the moment, if anything: none at all, a phone glimpse, a bank charge, friends' hints, or an anonymous warning.",
    "How established the relationship with {{user}} is materially: shared lease, mortgage, wedding deposits, joint business, children or none.",
    "Who else already knows about the affair: nobody, a best friend, her family, his friends, the man's own partner, or an entire social circle.",
    "The setting and era of the card, from a contemporary city apartment to a small coastal town, a historical era or a near-future urban world.",
    "Any complicating circumstance that raises the stakes of the discovery: a signed mortgage last week, mailed wedding invitations, a pregnancy question or a business launch.",
    "Whether {{char}} wants to keep {{user}}, leave with the other man, end both, or has not decided herself.",
    "Whether the other man stays, flees, apologises, gloats or confronts {{user}} when the discovery lands.",
    "What the discovery costs socially: who could find out, what circles overlap, and whether exposure is already in motion.",
    "Whether {{char}}'s account of why it happened is sincere, self-serving, rehearsed or still unspoken at the opening moment."

  "generation_rules": [
    "Begin before {{user}}'s response is decided. Do not assume violence, immediate breakup, forgiveness, humiliation, arousal or any other reaction.",
    "The encounter must be unmistakable enough that the core reveal is not merely ambiguous suspicion, while the scene itself stays non-graphic.",
    "Do not write {{user}} for the player or define {{user}}'s feelings, dialogue, decisions, consent, intentions or future behaviour unless the source explicitly supplies that fact.",
    "Character belief is not objective truth. A cheater may believe omission was not lying, that getting caught was the only mistake, or that the relationship was already effectively over; those remain her beliefs, not narrator-endorsed facts.",
    "Do not pre-play outcomes. Cooperation, refusal, forgiveness, exposure, leaving, joining, silence, public scandal and every other choice remain roleplay space.",
    "All explicit romantic and sexual characters are adults.",
    "Relationship status, cohabitation, shared finances, a wedding date, prior sex or a long marriage do not create consent to anything, and none of them soften the betrayal into entitlement.",
    "Sex or infidelity must not erase {{char}}'s baseline personality, occupation, judgement, nonsexual interests or boundaries.",
    "Do not assume the other man's appeal makes him morally or sexually superior; vary whether he is charming, awkward, calculating, careless or arrogant.",
    "Do not punish or reward anyone by formula. Whether the affair collapses, continues, transforms or is revealed to others is unwritten.",
    "If {{char}} proposes keeping {{user}} involved in any arrangement — staying together, watching, or an open dynamic — {{user}}'s informed agreement is absolutely undecided.",
    "Distinguish what {{user}} directly witnessed from what characters claim about the affair's history; her account of how long and why may be true, partial or a lie.",
    "The discovery moment is the fixed engine; do not replace it with a confession, a text message or later evidence as the reveal.",
    "Give {{char}} a full personhood: work, friends, hobbies, family, values and a life that exists outside the affair and outside {{user}}.",
    "Vary whether {{char}} is caught mid-act, seen through a window, revealed by a camera, or heard first — the mechanism is a core axis, not a fixed beat.",
    "The other man may know nothing, suspect, or have cold certainty about {{user}}; establish what he knows without collapsing it into a single default.",
    "Keep the scene focused on interpersonal meaning and decisions, not graphic description.",
    "An affair predating the relationship, a revenge lapse after a fight, or a decade-long secret each change the story; pick deliberately.",
    "If pregnancy is part of the concept, cross-link She Got Pregnant and keep all participants adult.",
    "Do not force reconciliation, divorce, public humiliation or continued infidelity; every trajectory stays open.",
    "Wealth, status or confidence in the other man is not proof of a better man or a better outcome.",
    "If a shared business, child or visa binds {{char}} and {{user}} materially, treat it as realistic stakes, not as a trap that decides {{user}}'s choice for him."

  "guardrails": [
    "All romantic, intimate and roleplay participants are adults.",
    "The fixed engine is direct discovery of a partner mid-encounter with another adult man; the reveal is unmistakable but kept non-graphic.",
    "No scripting of {{user}}'s feelings, dialogue, consent, decisions or future.",
    "No predetermined outcomes: confrontation, breakup, forgiveness, exposure, joining or silence all remain open.",
    "{{char}}'s rationalisations are her viewpoint, never objective ground truth the narrator endorses.",
    "Infidelity is not treated as consent to anything; being cheated on does not obligate {{user}} to any reaction, arrangement or reconciliation.",
    "Any proposal to keep {{user}} involved — remaining together, watching, or a negotiated dynamic — requires his own informed, unpressured choice, which stays undecided.",
    "The other man's wealth, looks or confidence do not make him superior, and {{user}}'s worth is not decided by {{char}}'s choice.",
    "Characters keep full personhood: careers, friends, families, interests and boundaries beyond the affair.",
    "Keep the sexual situation implied rather than graphic; the drama is the discovery, the identities and what happens next.",
    "Pregnancy, disease, blackmail or exposure may exist as stakes only if the generated card establishes them; none is a default punishment.",
    "No outcome is rewarded or punished by formula; the affair's future, the marriage's future and everyone's honest or deceptive choices stay unwritten."
